cause.finding: The account's five-hour rate limit was reached mid-run. The stream records rate_limit_event utilisation climbing to 0.98 with status allowed_warning, then a final rate_limit_info of status rejected, rateLimitType five_hour, overageDisabledReason org_level_disabled, and a result event reading 'You've hit your session limit - resets 9:10am (UTC)'.
cause.effect: Task 2 ended at the limit and the remaining four tasks were never attempted, so the recorded 77,017 weighted cost covered two of six tasks.
cause.not_an_agent_result: Nothing about the agent's behaviour produced this. The run was interrupted by the provider account, so the number measures an outage rather than a trajectory and is not a retainable replicate.

retention_policy_note: Retention protects replicates whose agent performed badly, which produce real measurements of real trajectories. This one measured an interruption, so it is replaced rather than kept.

retained.protocol: sources/evaluations/protocols/beets-lifecycle-sequence-v2-baseline-claude-code-no-mcp-cddd8b083dcc.json is cited by the r0 session and stays.

replacement: Re-run at the same replicate index after the limit reset at 09:10 UTC.
